content: Certain medications, including glucocorticoids, statins, and some antipsychotic drugs such as olanzapine, are known to increase the risk of developing diabetes. These medications necessitate regular monitoring because of their impact on metabolic parameters, such as blood glucose levels and body weight. It is recommended to screen for diabetes or prediabetes at the time of initiating these medications, again 12 to 16 weeks after starting the treatment, and subsequently on an annual basis.
